outcome: problems in the development of the newborn
cohort: 108 primiparous women attending the antenatal clinic of a hospital between February 27, 2015 and March 1, 2016.
finding: The pregnancy Pilates-assisted childbirth preparation training had a positive effect on fear of childbirth and neonatal outcomes, including mode of birth, Apgar score, and newborn body weight.
mod_finding: The training positively affected mode of birth.
